DECLARE @EMAILLIST VARCHAR(250)
DECLARE @EMAIL VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @MarketCalllist VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @R INT
DECLARE @TMP1 TABLE(EMAIL VARCHAR(100))

SET @MarketCalllist = LEFT(@item.name,3)

INSERT INTO @TMP1 
 SELECT CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_MARKET_CONTACTS_EMAIL 
 FROM PDS_CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_MARKET_CONTACTS
 WHERE CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_MARKET_CONTACTS_MARKET = @MarketCalllist

--SET @EMAILLIST = ''
SET @EMAILLIST = 'nccdevreq@amerigroup.com'

SELECT @R = COUNT(*) FROM @TMP1

WHILE @R > 0
BEGIN
 SELECT TOP 1 @EMAIL = EMAIL FROM @TMP1
 SET @EMAILLIST = @EMAILLIST + CASE WHEN @EMAILLIST='' THEN '' ELSE ';' END + @EMAIL
 DELETE FROM @TMP1 WHERE EMAIL = @EMAIL
 SELECT @R = COUNT(*) FROM @TMP1
END

SELECT @EMAILLIST AS EMAILLIST

--SELECT 'harika.mamidala@anthem.com' AS EMAILLIST

SELECT COUNT(CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER) AS NONCALLLISTJOBCOUNT 
FROM PDS_CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING DSS 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST CL ON DSS.CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD = CL.CALLLIST_CD 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
		(PDS_CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE CCR
